_notes.name: The name in the greeting, as in "Good morning, Sam". Leave it empty for a plain greeting.
_notes.habits: One to eight habits, in the order of the rings from the outside in. The dial draws the first five; the rest sit as chips with their own small ring. Each one has an id (lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; it is how a day records the habit, so keep it once you start), a label of one or two words, and an icon: water, run, walk, bike, lift, stretch, breathe, read, write, sleep, sun, leaf, sprout, cup, pill, heart, music, code, talk, no-phone, spark, or check. A color like "#ff6a3d" replaces the theme's ring color for that habit. A target from 2 to 99 makes a countable habit, like 8 glasses of water: each tap fills one step of the ring.
_notes.weekStart: "mon" or "sun": the first row of every year map. It can also be changed in the page's Settings.
_notes.theme: "auto" follows the device between paper (light) and ink (dark); "ink", "paper", or "neon" picks one. It can also be changed in the page's Settings.
_notes.nudgeHour: An hour from 0 to 23. While the page is open past it with rings still open, the headline says so.
_notes.sample: true shows a made-up year of history until it is cleared in Settings; false starts with an empty year.
